  include Comparable

  attr_reader :amount, :unit

  def initialize(amount, unit)
    @amount = amount
    @unit = unit
  end

    return nil unless Weight === other
    return nil unless unit == other.unit

    amount <=> other.amount
  end

  def <(other)
    ensure_same_unit_weight!(other)
    amount < other.amount
  end

  def <=(other)
    ensure_same_unit_weight!(other)
    amount <= other.amount
  end

  def >(other)
    ensure_same_unit_weight!(other)
    amount > other.amount
  end

  def >=(other)
    ensure_same_unit_weight!(other)
    amount >= other.amount
  end

  def between?(lower, upper)
    ensure_same_unit_weight!(lower)
    ensure_same_unit_weight!(upper)

    lower.amount <= amount && amount <= upper.amount
  end

  def clamp(*bounds)
    bounds.each { |bound| ensure_clamp_bound_units!(bound) }
    super(*bounds)
  end

  def ==(other)
    Weight === other && unit == other.unit && amount == other.amount
  end

  def eql?(other)
    Weight === other && unit == other.unit && amount == other.amount
  end

  def hash
    [amount, unit].hash
  end

  private

  def ensure_same_unit_weight!(other)
    unless Weight === other
      raise ArgumentError, "can't compare Weight with #{other.class}"
    end

    unless unit == other.unit
      raise ArgumentError, "can't compare Weights with different units"
    end
  end

  def ensure_clamp_bound_units!(bound)
    if bound.is_a?(Range)
      ensure_same_unit_weight!(bound.begin) unless bound.begin.nil?
      ensure_same_unit_weight!(bound.end) unless bound.end.nil?
    else
      ensure_same_unit_weight!(bound)
    end
  end
end

  def self.truncate(str, limit)
    limit = limit.to_i

      rescue StandardError

      end
      suffix = encoded if encoded && encoded.length == 1
    end

    if Encoding.compatible?(prefix, suffix)
      prefix + suffix
    else
      prefix.encode(Encoding::UTF_8, invalid: :replace, undef: :replace) + ELLIPSIS
    end
  end
end

class Proxy

end
